environment.cache: No cache purge or reboot. Fixtures written immediately before use. First linked-binary execution is ASCII sample 1; other fixture sample 1 is not a fresh binary.

baseline: 9258b7f + startup-profile instrumentation and fixed pre-exec PTY size, before layout/sanitize/height-resize optimization
statistics: Warm comparisons use median of samples 2-5. move_p95_ms is nearest-rank p95 within each 100-event run, then median across warm runs. Stage medians need not add to median total.

copy_control.description: Three distinct new file inodes, identical after-binary bytes. Three launches each. --moves 0; no concurrent build/benchmark.

balanced_control.description: before,after,after,before order; ascii/math; three launches each; --moves 0. Summaries exclude sample 1 of each fixture.

post_measurement_change: 計時終了後の計測JSON出力に既存ファイルの上書き防止を追加。通常のレイアウト処理と計時点は変更なし。
